## Research visits

**University of Nevada, Las Vegas** — UNLV summer research program (EIP) \
Four weeks, June – July 2025

A credit-bearing program in machine learning and data science: coursework and
assessment alongside a four-person team project on deep neural networks for
electronic health record data, supervised by Dr. Mingon Kang.
